findings.title: Unconditional membership access breaks token-authenticated requests
findings.description: `RpcUserOrganizationContext.member` can be `None`, including for organization-token authentication supported by `from_rpc_auth`. This unconditional dereference raises `AttributeError` even without `optimized_pagination=true`. Guard the optional membership and evaluate eligibility only when optimization is requested.

findings.title: Optimized paginator cannot handle datetime ordering
findings.description: The endpoint orders by `AuditLogEntry.datetime`, but `get_item_key` applies numeric rounding directly to that datetime. An isolated execution confirmed `TypeError`, so optimized requests with results fail while constructing cursors. Incoming cursor values also lack the timestamp conversion provided by `DateTimePaginator`. Reuse its datetime handling.

findings.title: Negative slicing does not implement reverse pagination
findings.description: Django querysets reject negative slice indices; they do not resolve them automatically as the comment claims. An optimized request with cursor `0:-1:0` reaches this slice and raises an exception rather than returning a page or validation error. Reject negative offsets with `BadPaginationError`, or implement reverse traversal using supported queries.
